body: GTA 6’s latest Extended Look gave fans another glimpse at just how detailed Rockstar’s vehicle lineup could be, with several cars appearing to closely resemble real-world models. Among the vehicles spotted are cars that look similar to the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34, Toyota GR86, Chevrolet Chevelle, Chevrolet Corvette C8, Mercedes-Benz CL65 AMG, Range Rover Discovery, BMW M2, BMW E30 Cabriolet and Ford F-150.
